assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The single added assertion is assert "export JAX_PERSISTENT_CACHE_ENABLE_XLA_CACHES=none" in PAYLOAD.read_text(). It reads the real payload file rather than a value the test supplied, so it is independent of the code under test: deleting the export line reddens it, which the negative control demonstrates.

findings.text: follow-on: the assertion is a substring match over the whole file, so '# export JAX_PERSISTENT_CACHE_ENABLE_XLA_CACHES=none' (the export commented out) still contains the asserted text and leaves the test green while the setting is inert. The negative control covers deletion but not commenting-out; a line-anchored or startswith check over a splitlines() pass would refuse both.

follow-on: the head arm and the manifest's after_suite both record revision 52702d307482ec0f35e0276e98c21c3a81d1cc91, the base, because the gate ran on the uncommitted working tree before 2c080ff7b was created; the after_suite revision therefore does not name the head it measured. The 12-vs-11 test count shows the run did contain the added test, so the evidence stands; the revision field alone is stale.
